title: Data and machine learning
description: PyPI and Hugging Face open, more memory; the GPU if you give one.
notes: The GPU, if given: dri (Intel/AMD, /dev/dri), rocm (AMD, /dev/kfd and /dev/dri) or nvidia (Podman with a CDI specification: sudo nvidia-ctk cdi generate --output=/etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml). A GPU weakens the isolation; the security modes high and paranoid refuse it.
CUDA or ROCm libraries come from an image variant of yours (sandbox-ai images new NAME --from AGENT), started with --image-variant NAME.
